newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on gains by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on gains by blue chips.

text.p: Dhaka stocks, boosted by good corporate news, closed 2.63 percent higher amid a buying pressure ahead of Moslem Friday weekend, brokers said.

"Market was under buying pressure. Most blue chips gained. Investors' confidence bolstered by good corporate news such as the Olympic Industries having tie-up with a foreign firm," said one broker. The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index rose 2.63 percent or 56.41 points at 2.193.80 on a turnover of 334.5 million taka. Of 102 issues traded, 60 rose, 40 lost and two unchanged.
Apex Foods gained 1,420 taka to 15,622, Shine Pukur Holdings rose 3.11 to 199.54 and Square Pharama was up 147.59 at 1,632.79.
